text: Cellular automata in the loop: hand-made rules as nets
description: Express classic CAs (Game of Life-like, reaction-diffusion, Lenia, smooth-life) in the same per-pixel net format (taps on the mip pyramid, hidden state), run them on the splat-reprojected state. Mip taps make them multi-scale for free. Compare to trained and random nets by look and ms.
